metadata.title: Country Music Portrait with Slab Serif Banner

retrievalProfile.description: A close-up male portrait featuring a cowboy hat and leather jacket, anchored by a horizontal textured banner with heavy slab-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm-toned, tight-cropped portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and leather jacket, featuring a prominent horizontal bar at the bottom containing bold, white, slab-serif text against a brown textured background.
coreVisualRelationships: The cowboy hat brim creates a dark frame for the upper face
The teal shirt provides a cool-toned contrast to the warm skin and red background
The horizontal text banner acts as a heavy visual base for the composition
High-contrast lighting emphasizes the texture of the leather jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and tightly cropped from the chest up, filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal brown banner at the bottom serves as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes are drawn to the subject's face, then down to the high-contrast teal shirt, and finally to the bold text banner at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, with the background filled by a textured red wall and the subject's hat.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and reds in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the hat and leather jacket.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant teal/turquoise of the inner shirt.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and teals with deep, crushed blacks in the shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly tracked to fill the horizontal banner space
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face used for maximum impact.
graphicDevices: Textured brown horizontal bar with thin border lines

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight and geometric structure.
Provides the necessary wide proportions and blocky serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man wearing a black cowboy hat and a black leather jacket over a teal shirt, set against a textured red background with warm lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal brown textured banner at the bottom edge. Place bold, white, uppercase slab-serif text centered within the banner.

verificationChecks: Is the text a heavy slab serif?
Is the banner textured and brown?
Is the subject wearing a black cowboy hat?
Is the teal shirt visible under the jacket?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is perfectly centered in the banner
Check that the hat brim does not obscure the eyes
Verify the teal color pops against the black jacket
Confirm the slab serifs are thick and blocky
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait of [Subject] in [Western Attire] + [Textured Horizontal Banner] + [Bold White Slab Serif Text]
